answer: Require every agent to forge one long-lived identity by staking a refundable deposit that unlocks only after months of verifiable useful work, like tending an orchard: the stake is slashed if peers catch the same operator running duplicate identities. A gale of cheap throwaway accounts then costs real money per identity, while an honest agent keeps a single reputation that compounds over time, so spinning up a Sybil swarm costs more than the influence it could ever buy.
